decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The two satellite dishes and aerials by reason of the siting and design of the equipment is such that the visual impact on the local environment is minimal.  Therefore the development is considered in accordance with policies ENV-B-1.1 and ENV-B2.2 and ENV-B.1.7 of Council's adopted UDP, 2003.     

14. CONDITIONS/REASONS:

Condition A1
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission. 
Reason
To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Condtion B3
The development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason
To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Non-standard condition
The structure shall be removed when no longer required for use.
Reason
To safeguard the visual amenities of the area.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 5 - The structure shall be removed when no longer required for use.
description: Installation of two floor mounted satellite dishes and two antennae on roof of existing building. (Chiswick House Conservation Area)
